title: Seventy miles an hour
evenTitle: He can't have been ... He must have been ...
evenTitleZh: 他那时不可能……他那时肯定是……

words.zh: 从后面超越，超车（过去式 overtook，过去分词 overtaken）

dialogue.speaker: Ann
dialogue.en: Look, Gary!
dialogue.zh: 瞧，加里！

dialogue.speaker: Ann
dialogue.en: That policeman's waving to you.
dialogue.zh: 那个警察正朝你挥手呢。

dialogue.speaker: Ann
dialogue.en: He wants you to stop.
dialogue.zh: 他要你停下来。

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.en: Where do you think you are?
dialogue.zh: 你认为你现在是在哪儿？

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.en: On a race track?
dialogue.zh: 在赛车道上吗？

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.en: You must have been driving at seventy miles an hour.
dialogue.zh: 你刚才一定是以每小时 70 英里的速度开车。

dialogue.speaker: Gary
dialogue.en: I can't have been.
dialogue.zh: 我不会开得那样快的。

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.en: I was doing eighty when I overtook you.
dialogue.zh: 我是以每小时 80 英里的速度赶上你的。

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.en: Didn't you see the speed limit?
dialogue.zh: 难道你没看见限速牌吗？

dialogue.speaker: Gary
dialogue.en: I'm afraid I didn't, officer.
dialogue.zh: 恐怕我没有看见，警官。

dialogue.speaker: Gary
dialogue.en: I must have been dreaming.
dialogue.zh: 我一定是思想开小差了。

dialogue.speaker: Ann
dialogue.en: He wasn't dreaming, officer.
dialogue.zh: 警官，他思想没有开小差。

dialogue.speaker: Ann
dialogue.en: I was telling him to drive slowly.
dialogue.zh: 我刚才正告诉他开慢点。

dialogue.speaker: Gary
dialogue.en: That's why I didn't see the sign.
dialogue.zh: 所以我才没看见那牌子。

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.en: Let me see your driving licence.
dialogue.zh: 让我看一看你的驾驶执照。

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.en: I won't charge you this time.
dialogue.zh: 这次我就不罚你款了。

dialogue.speaker: Policeman
dialogue.en: But you'd better not do it again!
dialogue.zh: 但你最好不要再开得这样快。

dialogue.speaker: Gary
dialogue.en: Thank you.
dialogue.zh: 谢谢您。

dialogue.speaker: Gary
dialogue.en: I'll certainly be more careful.
dialogue.zh: 我以后一定会多加注意。

dialogue.speaker: Ann
dialogue.en: I told you to drive slowly, Gary.
dialogue.zh: 加里，我刚才叫你开慢点吧。

dialogue.speaker: Gary
dialogue.en: You always tell me to drive slowly, darling.
dialogue.zh: 你总是叫我开慢点，亲爱的。

dialogue.speaker: Ann
dialogue.en: Well, next time you'd better take my advice!
dialogue.zh: 好啦，下次你最好还是听从我的劝告吧！

drills.zh: 你刚才一定是以每小时 70 英里的速度开车。

drills.zh: 我是以每小时 80 英里的速度赶上你的。

让我看一看你的驾驶执照。

drills.en: It can't have been my new hat. It ___ have been my old one.
drills.zh: 不可能是我的新帽子。肯定是我的旧帽子。

drills.en: He didn't come to work yesterday. He must have ___ ill.
drills.zh: 他昨天没来上班。他肯定是病了。
